messages:
incident-bot: Alert: High queueing latency on runtime-pool-us-west (avg queue 420ms, p95 1.2s). Triggered policy: runtime_backpressure_high. Paging oncall-sam :rotating_light:
oncall-sam: Seeing increased 429s and latency spikes for several customers, taking pager. Spinning up triage. Anyone on call can assist?
lisa-sre: I'm here, joining. Any obvious customer correlation?
oncall-sam: Looks like a spike from a single heavy-embed customer (~25% traffic) plus a few bursty chat tenants. Cache hit-rate dropped.
mike-runtime: Noted. Could be KV-cache eviction due to long sequences. I'm checking inflight counts and max_inflight per-tenant settings.
englead-ana: Heads up we'll likely need a live mitigation: temporary quota bump for critical customers + soft-shedding non-critical lanes.
csm-rajesh: Which customers are impacted? I need to notify two enterprise contacts if we force-shed or throttle.
oncall-sam: Impacted: corp-alpha (heavy embeds), startup-beta (chat), analytics-gamma (batch). corp-alpha is highest priority.
lisa-sre: Plan proposal: 1) increase corp-alpha quota by +30% for 15 minutes; 2) apply rate cap 50r/s per-tenant soft-shed to public/free tier; 3) reduce max_inflight for low-priority lane from 12 -> 6; 4) extend request timeout from 10s -> 8s for long-context models to free up resources faster.
mike-runtime: I can roll the changes. CLI snippets: 
```
# bump tenant quota
redwoodctl tenants update corp-alpha --quota-rps 130
# set soft-shed policy for free tier
redwoodctl policies set free-tier --soft-shed 50
# adjust runtime config
redwoodctl runtime update --lane low-priority --max-inflight 6 --timeout-ms 8000
```
I'll prepare a canary and then apply globally.
oncall-sam: Please also toggle the heavy-embedding experimental feature off for non-enterprise tenants. That should drop KV churn.
mike-runtime: Toggle command:
```
redwoodctl feature toggle embedding-optimizer --off --scope non-enterprise
```
Executing canary now on pool: runtime-pool-us-west-2a -> monitoring.
incident-bot: Change executed by mike-runtime at 1712350022: quota bump corp-alpha=+30%, soft-shed free-tier=50r/s, max_inflight low-priority=6, timeout long-context=8s, feature embedding-optimizer=off (non-enterprise).
lisa-sre: Canary looks good (p50 queue 120ms, p95 350ms for canary slice). Rolling to remaining hosts.
csm-rajesh: Messaging queued to corp-alpha and startup-beta: short note about temporary quota change and potential elevated error rates for free tier. I'll send now.
englead-ana: Good. Keep customers informed if mitigation extends beyond 30m. Prioritize rollback to normal config as soon as metrics stable.
oncall-sam: Post-mitigation checklist: 1) monitor error budget for enterprise customers, 2) collect sample traces for KV eviction events, 3) schedule follow-up to revisit embedding-optimizer memory profile.
mike-runtime: Rolling complete at 1712350680. Metrics: cluster queue avg 180ms, p95 420ms. No new 500s.
lisa-sre: Please keep alert thresholds lowered for next hour. I'll remove pager when stable for 20m.
csm-rajesh: Sent customer note to contacts, waiting ack from corp-alpha PM.
incident-bot: Alert: mitigations in place, incident status: mitigated -> monitoring.
oncall-sam: Thank you team. If corp-alpha reports issues, escalate to englead-ana and we'll consider dedicated capacity.
englead-ana: Thanks all. Log summary for postmortem: root cause suspected embedding-optimizer memory pressure + traffic spike from corp-alpha. Action items: deeper mem profiling, tenant isolation review, alert tuning.
lisa-sre: I'll kick off the follow-up doc and assign owners. Removing pager in 20m if stable. :white_check_mark:
